string.text: {=!}You want the quick version? Good. It is the only version I tell twice.
{=!}I carried messages and scouted roads for Sturgian warbands. Snow closes a pass, a river takes a bridge, and suddenly the fastest rider is the one who knows when to leave the horse behind.

{=!}Raiders learned my uniform, so I made a new one from whatever I could trade, borrow, or take. Ask five witnesses what I wore and you will hear six different answers. That is useful when someone is hunting a courier.

{=!}One winter I crossed the forest ahead of a raiding band and reached the village before their scouts. Everyone kept shouting for haste. The village survived, the raiders did not, and Hasted was the name that remained.
{=!}A scout who can outrun trouble would be useful.
{=!}Or you are a courier with a talent for improving his own story.

{=!}Call it what you like. I know the northern roads, I can read tracks, and I can throw a spear while other men are still deciding where to stand. If you need to arrive before the trouble does, hire me.
{=!}I am a Sturgian scout and skirmisher. I find quick roads, spot ambushes, and make sure my employer reaches trouble before trouble reaches them.
